title: Stakeholder and Decision-Maker Discovery

discovery_questions.question: Who owns the business outcome this website is expected to improve?
discovery_questions.purpose: Identify accountability for objectives and measurement.

discovery_questions.question: Who can approve scope, budget, content, and production release?
discovery_questions.purpose: Identify decision authority and approval paths.

discovery_questions.question: Which teams operate or maintain the current website and connected systems?
Which users or teams will be materially affected by the change?
discovery_questions.purpose: Identify affected audiences and workflow owners.

discovery_questions.question: Are any requirements disputed between stakeholders?
discovery_questions.purpose: Surface conflicts instead of silently choosing a preferred interpretation.

rules: Do not assume that the person requesting a website change has authority to approve every decision.
Distinguish stakeholders, users, approvers, and operational owners.
Record absent decision-makers when their approval is required.
Route disagreements through an explicit decision process.
Do not infer stakeholder priorities from job titles alone.
